references.quote: KC has a unique cross-disciplinary view of the world that's both refreshing and effective. He understands UX like no one else, and brings out the best in every team he leads. There are some people you'd hire again, any time, any day. KC is one of them.
references.name: Paul Salzinger

references.quote: One of the most visionary and impactful leaders I've worked with. Before AI became mainstream, he was already upskilling the team and championing AI-driven product ideas that pushed us to think differently about the future.
references.name: Nancy Rekhelman
references.role: UX Design & Research Lead, Genuine Parts Company

references.quote: When it comes to AI, he may be one of the few leaders who truly gets it — and can guide a team through the transformation needed to meaningfully embed and embrace it.
references.name: Tree Kraj
references.role: Product & UX Operations Lead, Genuine Parts Company

references.quote: He translated business and editorial goals into effective strategy. His focus on results was crucial to growth from zero to one million average monthly uniques in under eight months.
references.name: Ryan W. Kimball
references.role: Sr. Manager, Design Foundations, Motorola Mobility

references.quote: We reached out to KC to guide product strategy and design for our new iPhone app. He contributed brilliant ideas and built us a team of UI/UX superstars to get us to launch.
references.name: Joel Middendorf

references.quote: If you're looking for a transformational leader within technology, look no further than KC. Working under him accelerated my abilities by at least three years.
references.name: Wesley Smith

references.quote: Under his leadership, our team won an Emmy, a Royal Television Society Award, and countless internal successes. A mentor, a role model, and a top-notch product manager.
references.name: Stephen Dimmick

references.quote: In over 25 years, reporting to dozens of different managers, KC was the clear winner. He's an amazing manager — I still miss his ideas and his keen observations.
references.name: Jorge Monteiro
